ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Remote Desktop Tunneling
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential use of an SSH utility to establish RDP over a reverse SSH Tunnel. This can be used by attackers to enable routing of network packets that would otherwise not reach their intended destination.

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:3389.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-L\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-P\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-R\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-pw\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-ssh\\ .*")))
